title: Honey Glazed Indian Idli
description: A sweet and spicy twist on the traditional Indian idli, topped with a sticky honey glaze.

ingredients.name: crunchy
ingredients.notes: chopped nuts or seeds for garnish

instructions: In a small saucepan, combine honey and mirin. Heat over low heat until warm and syrupy.
Brush the idlis with the honey glaze and bake for 5-7 minutes, or until caramelized.
Garnish with crunchy toppings and serve warm.
Optional: Sprinkle a pinch of yeasty extract for added flavor.
